description: Sound design and music: loudness (LUFS) over time, silences, onsets (hits, impacts, clicks), tempo and beat grid, and how many cuts land on a beat (when `style` ran first). Returns a spectrogram picture: rising sweeps are risers or whooshes, vertical lines are hits, horizontal bands are tones and music beds. Writes audio-*.json and adds beats to motion-spec.json.

end.description: Range end (default the end, at most 10 minutes at a time).

source.description: The video: a link (YouTube and other sites), a path to a local file, or `inbox` for the newest file in the inbox folder.

name: audio
title: Analyze the sound
